An index of occupational exposure to GenAI: task automation scores (technical feasibility) aggregated to ISCO-08 occupations in four gradients, with estimated employment shares exposed. evidence.record_quote: It is important to stress that these new estimates reflect “exposure” to GenAI and not the actual impact on employment.
our estimates present a static snapshot of the exposure of existing occupations to GenAI at the start of 2025.

One in four workers across the world are in an occupation with some degree of GenAI exposure, but because of the continued need for human input, most jobs will be transformed rather than made redundant.

Globally, one in four workers are in an occupation with some GenAI exposure. 3.3% of global employment falls into the highest exposure category, albeit with significant differences between female (4.7%) and male employment (2.4%).
